name: Beekeeper Marguerite

intro.text: Honey from the hives in the walled garden. Perhaps more of a bribe than a prize. We'll see.

win: Stung! Not by the bees. By the defeat. Have a honey sandwich.
after: Cotswold limestone holds the day's heat like a storage heater, so the bees love it. A hive against a south-facing honey wall is worth ten in the open.
